values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A draft environmental impact statement from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission for the proposed Gulf LNG Liquefaction Project names the Destin Pipeline Company system. It describes modifications at the Destin Meter Station and bi-directional flow on the Destin line. The terminal is an import terminal, and the liquefaction project was only proposed, so the export flag is left blank.

verifications.note: A FERC draft EIS for the Gulf LNG Liquefaction Project. It names the Destin Pipeline Company system and the Destin Meter Station, and describes bi-directional flow on the Destin line.

records.researcher_notes: The Gulf LNG terminal near Pascagoula is listed as an import terminal. The FERC draft EIS ties the Destin line to a proposed liquefaction expansion, but the project was not built, so the export flag stays blank and the tier is low. No terminal was on the sheet before. On 17 November 2026 the flag column changed from yes or blank to export or import, and this line is marked import, because Gulf LNG is an import terminal and the liquefaction project was not built.
